name: Mermaid CLI
description: Open-source local command-line tool (mmdc) that renders Mermaid diagram definitions to SVG/PNG/PDF; not a hosted API service.
access_notes: MIT-licensed npm package (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli); install and run locally with no account or credentials. It also exposes a local Node.js API, but no hosted endpoint.
mcp_notes: mermaid-cli itself has no MCP. Mermaid Chart (the commercial product from the Mermaid team, a distinct product from this OSS CLI) hosts an official remote MCP at https://mcp.mermaid.ai/mcp whose core validate/render tools work without auth. No Composio toolkit found (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/mermaid returns 404).
uncertainty_notes: Row evaluated as the mermaid-js/mermaid-cli OSS tool per the assignment hint. Hosted alternatives exist but are different products: mermaid.ink is a third-party open-source rendering service (github.com/jihchi/mermaid.ink, not the mermaid-js org), and Mermaid Chart offers a hosted MCP and account API tokens. Neither makes mermaid-cli itself a remote API.

evidence.note: 'a command-line interface (CLI) for mermaid. It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output'; only local CLI and Node.JS API
MIT-licensed npm package, installed and run locally; no credentials or hosted service involved
mermaid.ink is a separate hosted image-rendering service (third-party open source, jihchi/mermaid.ink), not an official mermaid-js hosted API

Mermaid Chart's official hosted MCP server (https://mcp.mermaid.ai/mcp); core validation/rendering tools need no auth, account tools need a Mermaid Chart API token — a different product from mermaid-cli
